title: nix-darwin host manifest
description: config/hosts.json: the list of hosts built by the flake. Membership of defaultHost in hosts is checked by scripts/validate-host-json.sh and the Nix loader, not by this schema.

hosts.description: Host names; each must have a matching config/hosts/<name>.json.

defaultHost.description: Optional host used by default builds. Must be one of hosts (checked outside this schema).
